ts = np.linspace(-T, T, n_grid + 1)
    vs = np.array([g(t) for t in ts])
    slopes = np.diff(vs) / np.diff(ts)
    kinks = []

    def refine(a, b, sa, sb, depth=0):
        # slopes sa (just right of a) and sb (just left of b) differ
        if depth > 60 or b - a < 1e-13:
            kinks.append(0.5 * (a + b))
            return
        fa, fb = g(a), g(b)
        t = (fb - fa + sa * a - sb * b) / (sa - sb)
        if a < t < b:
            ft = g(t)
            pred = fa + sa * (t - a)
            tol = 1e-9 * (1 + abs(ft))
            if abs(ft - pred) < tol:
                # check it's a single kink: slope just around t matches
                dl = min(1e-6, (t - a) / 4)
                dr = min(1e-6, (b - t) / 4)
